description: Bulk wallet vetting — ONE call returns Base ETH + USDC balances for up to 50 EVM addresses (pass ?addresses=0xA,0xB,… or POST {"addresses":[…]}) at 50% of the single-call price. Built for pipeline agents, x402 payer-vetting observatories and copy-trade desks that check a whole basket per loop instead of paying per address. Use for batch wallet health checks, airdrop/allowlist screening, payer vetting at scale, and treasury monitoring.
name: akari_batch
